segments.sn35.206:1.4: Yadanattā taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ … pe … jivhā aniccā paccuppannā.
segments.sn35.206:1.8: Yadanattā, taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ … pe … mano anicco paccuppanno.
segments.sn35.206:1.12: Yadanattā, taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn35.206:1.13: Evaṃ passaṃ … pe … nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī”ti.
